text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the mock races.
While waiting for the next race to begin...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. If you don't mind, I would like
to hear your opinion for reference.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Checking the right moment to make our move based on the weather, track conditions, and the opponents' past race records...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tactical positioning plans during the run designed to adapt to unforeseen circumstances, and so on――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Preparations heading into this race should be thorough,
but I still feel like something is missing...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If there is any way to raise our win rate even by a single percent,
I want to push that possibility to its limit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What do you consider the most crucial thing to do
before a race? I'd like to hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did that...
Wait, are you saying I need to do even more?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. Pushing one's training right down to the wire... That never crossed my mind... A fresh perspective.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All I can really do right now is... strength training, I guess.
Alright, I'll head over to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Either way, warming up your body
is never going to be a waste of effort.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your advice from such a novel perspective.
Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How could I forget? Comparative study is an absolute must for any debate. Analyzing past races and the like—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No... are you saying I should check the course right beforehand?
Certainly, turf conditions and such are necessary for inference, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, I can't get a multi-angle view from here. Should I ask to climb up to the watchtower? No, that'd be going too far...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry for muttering to myself.
Anyway, thank you. I'll take it into consideration.
